segments.speaker: AE
segments.text: Hi Rachel, hi Linda. Thanks for making the time. Linda, I know Rachel's filled you in so I'll keep this tight.

segments.speaker: CFO
segments.text: Please do. I've seen the numbers Rachel sent over. What I need to understand is what this costs and what it costs if we start with a pilot and walk away.

segments.speaker: AE
segments.text: Fair. Let me start with your numbers, not hours. Rachel told us you wrote off about $90,000 last year between spoiled loads and warm delivery credits, with the credits running about $5,000 a month. And someone in the office spends about two hours a day pulling stop sheets together, which is over 500 hours a year.

segments.speaker: OPS
segments.text: That's right.

segments.speaker: OPS
segments.text: And that's a normal week. During the audit, it's going to be all day, every day, and I can't spare anybody for that.

segments.speaker: CFO
segments.text: OK and on your side.

segments.speaker: AE
segments.text: For 38 trucks plus the warehouse, the hardware comes to about $31,000. Installation is about $4,500. Software is $1,260 a month. All in, year one is right around $50,000.

segments.speaker: CFO
segments.text: That's more than we planned. We set aside about 40,000 for food safety this year, and that number already had some other things in it.

segments.speaker: AE
segments.text: Understood. And if the alerts catch even half of what you lost last year, they cover most of that on their own.

segments.speaker: CFO
segments.text: Maybe, but Frostgauge came in a lot cheaper, and honestly, if we waited in...

segments.speaker: OPS
segments.text: We can't wait, Linda. The audit's the week of the 19th, and without records for every delivery, we could lose the account.

segments.speaker: CFO
segments.text: I know, next quarter would just be easier on the budget, and their hardware quote was about 30% under yours, so I have to ask why we'd pay more.

segments.speaker: OPS
segments.text: Because they don't have a driver app, and half our

segments.speaker: CFO
segments.text: Besarentave как играет East Coast im trapped inside of St edges of light inside of state road safety and gamma Koala currency.

segments.speaker: OPS
segments.text: routes are in dead zones. Without the app, we'd have the same gaps in the records we have now.

segments.speaker: AE
segments.text: What if we start with the pilot? Four trucks for 30 days, and if the alerts don't do what we said, you walk away and owe nothing for the software.

segments.speaker: CFO
segments.text: I'd want that in writing, a pilot first with a clean opt-out after 30 days.

segments.speaker: AE
segments.text: We can do that, and to protect your timeline, I can probably get the installation waived.

segments.speaker: OPS
segments.text: Oh, that helps.

segments.speaker: CFO
segments.text: That would help, and after the pilot, is the software month to month, or are we signing up for a year?

segments.speaker: AE
segments.text: It's an annual agreement billed monthly.

segments.speaker: CFO
segments.text: Okay, and the two trucks in the shop. I'm not paying for hardware on trucks that aren't running.

segments.speaker: AE
segments.text: You won't. The price covers the $38 on the road, and the other two get sensors when they're back.

segments.speaker: CFO
segments.text: Good, what does the paperwork look like?

segments.speaker: AE
segments.text: Our master agreement and an order form. Your counsel would review the agreement and then you'd issue a purchase order.

segments.speaker: CFO
segments.text: Our outside counsel usually takes about a week, then purchasing needs a couple of days, and we pay everything net 45, so I'll need that in the order form.

segments.speaker: AE
segments.text: Net 45 is fine.

segments.speaker: OPS
segments.text: So if we want the whole fleet installed before the audit, we'd need a signature by October 2nd. Installs take about four days at 10 trucks a day.

segments.speaker: AE
segments.text: That works on our side. Here's what I'd suggest. I'll send a revised proposal with the pilot clause in the net 45 terms by Thursday, and Linda, you'd let us know by Wednesday the 30th.

segments.speaker: CFO
segments.text: That's fair, send it Thursday and I'll decide by the 30th.

segments.speaker: OPS
segments.text: And I'll make sure Council has it the day it comes in.

segments.speaker: AE
segments.text: Thank you both. I'll have it to you Thursday.
